statement.text:
For a finite group G, let χ1 (G) denote the totality of the degrees of all irre-
ducible complex characters of G with allowance for their multiplicities. Suppose that
H is a finite group with χ1 (H) = χ1 (G).
   a) If G is an almost simple group, must H be isomorphic to G?
   b) If G is a quasisimple group, must H be isomorphic to G?
   This is true if G is a simple group (see 11.8(a) in Archive).
                                                               A. Iranmanesh, F. Shirjian
